mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an extremely accommodative monetary policy that boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong labor market growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production growth rate below -2% signals a supply chain disruption that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the industrial production growth rate is below -2% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in the federal funds rate and a decline in the consumer price index signals a monetary policy tightening cycle that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of monetary policy tightening (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate above 9% signals a weak labor market that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when the unemployment rate is above 9% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in retail sales and a decline in the personal savings rate signals a strong demand environment that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong retail sales growth (t-test p > 0.05).
